Module com.example.miniproyecto_batalla_naval
Package com.example.miniproyecto_batalla_naval.view

Class GameStage

java.lang.Object
com.example.miniproyecto_batalla_naval.view.GameStage
public final class GameStage extends Object
Utility class responsible for managing scene navigation throughout the Battleship application. This class loads the corresponding FXML views, initializes their controllers when necessary, and replaces the current scene displayed on the primary application stage.
